title: brassica oleracea subsp. gemmifera
intro: Brassica oleracea subsp. gemmifera, commonly known as Brussels sprouts, is a cool-season crop belonging to the Brassicaceae family. This nutritious vegetable is rich in vitamins C and K, fiber, and antioxidants, offering various health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and supporting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Brussels sprouts are attributed to their bioactive constituents, including glucosinolates, isothiocyanates, and polyphenols, which have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-cancer properties. Regular consumption of Brussels sprouts may also help lower the risk of chronic diseases, such as heart disease, diabetes, and certain types of cancer.
